summary: Marketing executive with 8+ years scaling revenue and building marketing infrastructure across B2B manufacturing, D2C retail, and health tech. Builds CRM and automation systems end-to-end and leads cross-functional teams to measurable growth. Equally effective managing seven-figure budgets and building a channel from zero on a lean one.

Productized a direct-booking infrastructure service for hospitality: positioning, pricing, and acquisition funnel built end-to-end.
Scaled monthly revenue 10x within the first 18 months on a $2K/mo ad budget.
Grew qualified inbound from 2 to 15 leads/day.
Cut lead response time from an inconsistent ~30 min average to a sub-2-minute SLA via automation.
Built LTV and retention infrastructure from scratch, consolidating 5+ channels into a single system and enabling automated retention campaigns where none existed.
Built go-to-market positioning and paid acquisition from scratch for a new iOS/Android app; held CAC at $3–5 in competitive US/EU markets.
Led a cross-functional team of 5 from planning to public launch in ~4 months.
Managed $1M+ annual marketing budget across digital channels.
Grew inbound lead generation from 0 to 1,000+ qualified leads/month via Google Ads, SEO, and content.
Moved key product pages from 500+ positions to top 10 within ~12 months.
Drove digital expansion across 20+ markets (Russia, CIS, EU, Africa), coordinating with European HQ.
Built and managed a structured network of 50+ dealers supporting B2B distribution.
